# aj board

Work with boards.


## `aj board list`

List boards.

```text
aj board list [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-q`, `--name` `TEXT` |  | Name contains. |
| `-t`, `--type` `TEXT` |  | scrum, kanban or simple. |
| `-p`, `--project` `TEXT` |  | Boards about this project. |
| `--filter` `TEXT` |  | Boards using this filter id. |
| `--order` `TEXT` |  | Sort by name: name, or -name for Z to A. |
| `--private` |  | Also list private boards (Jira hides their names). |
| `-l`, `--limit` `INTEGER` | `50` | Show at most this many results. |
| `-A`, `--all` |  | Fetch every page, ignoring --limit. |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |
| `--csv` |  | Print CSV. |


## `aj board view`

Show a board's details.

```text
aj board view BOARD [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `BOARD` | required | Board id (see `aj board list`). |
| `-w`, `--web` |  | Open it in the browser instead. |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |


## `aj board create`

Create a board from a saved filter.

```text
aj board create [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--name` `TEXT` | required | Board name. |
| `--filter` `INTEGER` | required | Saved filter id that feeds it. |
| `-t`, `--type` `TEXT` | `kanban` | scrum or kanban. |
| `-p`, `--project` `TEXT` |  | Put it in this project (else your own board). |
| `-n`, `--dry-run` |  | Show what would change without changing anything. Reads still run. |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |


## `aj board delete`

Delete boards (their issues and filters stay).

```text
aj board delete BOARDS [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `BOARDS` | required | Board ids. |
| `-y`, `--yes` |  | Don't ask for confirmation. |
| `--ignore-errors` |  | Keep going when one item fails; exit 1 at the end. |
| `-n`, `--dry-run` |  | Show what would change without changing anything. Reads still run. |


## `aj board projects`

List the projects a board shows.

```text

```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `BOARD` | required | Board id (see `aj board list`). |
| `-l`, `--limit` `INTEGER` | `50` | Show at most this many results. |
| `-A`, `--all` |  | Fetch every page, ignoring --limit. |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |
| `--csv` |  | Print CSV. |


## `aj board backlog`


| Option | Default | Description |

| `BOARD` | required | Board id (see `aj board list`). |
| `-q`, `--jql` `TEXT` |  | Act on the issues this JQL finds. |

| `-A`, `--all` |  | Fetch every page, ignoring --limit. |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |
| `--csv` |  | Print CSV. |


## `aj board sprints`

List a board's sprints.

```text

```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `BOARD` |  | Board id (default: config). |
| `-s`, `--state` `TEXT` |  | future, active or closed (repeatable). |

| `--csv` |  | Print CSV. |
